findings.detail: next/font loads "Roboto Mono" with display: "block", which can hide the text for up to about 3 seconds while the font downloads. Rule: set font-display on every web font: swap by default, fallback or optional by choice, block only for icon fonts. Reason: hidden text delays first paint and LCP; fix the shift from a late swap with a metric-matched fallback, not by hiding text. Fix: remove the display option (next/font defaults to "swap") or set display: "swap".

next/font/google preloads "Roboto Mono" for latin only, while other next/font calls in this project also preload latin-ext. Text in those subsets gets a "Roboto Mono" file that is not preloaded and can swap in late. Fix: give every next/font call the subsets your text uses.

next/font/google loads "Playfair Display" with preload on (the default) but no subsets, so Next.js cannot tell which files to preload and warns or fails the build. Fix: add the subsets your text uses, for example subsets: ["latin"], or set preload: false.

"Playfair Display" declares weight 800 here (next/font weight), but nothing in the scanned files sets font-weight 800 where this family could apply. Fix: remove this weight, unless something the scan cannot see applies it (styles set by scripts, CMS content).
